title: Senior Learning Experience Specialist
jobDescription:
Senior Learning Experience Specialist English | Full-Time | Work From Office “Empower Educators. Inspire Learners. Shape the Future of English Learning.” About Us Are you excited about a (quite literally) game-changing idea? Does the cocktail of English, gaming, and tech give you an adrenaline rush? Then we have a lot to talk about. We are a Math and English-based Ed Tech company founded by the World's Fastest Human Calculator, Neelakantha Bhanu — a team of enthusiasts reimagining contemporary education through pedagogy-driven courseware. Our singular focus is on delivering strong student outcomes through a gamified engagement model. Why Bhanzu? We're on a mission to revolutionize how English is taught across the globe — and we need people who feel that in their bones, not just on their résumé. Experience matters. But passion? That's non-negotiable. What You Bring to the Table At Bhanzu , we're not filling seats — we're building a movement. If you wake up thinking about how to make learning more powerful, more engaging, and more human, we want to talk. You're not just qualified — you're driven . Here's what your profile looks like: A Bachelor's or Master's in Education, English, Communication, or a related field 3+ years of experience in teacher training, quality assurance, curriculum design or a similar arena A deep understanding of pedagogy, classroom dynamics, and what makes a great trainer great Where You Could Land We currently have multiple openings across three powerhouse teams in our English Department: Teacher Training: Shape and sharpen the educators who teach thousands. Quality Control: Set the gold standard for classroom excellence. Curriculum: Design the learning journeys that change lives. Key Responsibilities You'll mentor trainers, lead impactful sessions, and uphold quality standards that sets Bhanzu apart
- your work will ripple across classrooms worldwide Define and uphold quality standards — rubrics, evaluation frameworks, and performance benchmarks that set Bhanzu's classrooms apart Analyze learning and classroom data to identify gaps, then design creative, pedagogy-grounded solutions Lead high-impact sessions — trainer workshops, calibration meetings, or curriculum walkthroughs — that inspire action A Few Key Details Work From Office (WFO) — this is a hands-on, in-person role (non-negotiable) Compensation: Your CTC will be determined based on the role and team you're placed in (up to 8 LPA). Application Process: Apply once → our team reaches out → you speak directly with our Learning Experience Head → together, we find the role that fits you best. We want you to find your perfect role — and for us to find our perfect fit. Apply Now 👉 https://forms.gle/7Yb Prh Rh Mm YYep Xr8 If English education is your calling — Bhanzu is your stage. Let's build something extraordinary together.

title: Full Stack Engineer

Material-UI Gatsby HTML5, CSS3, Java Script (ES6+) Databases Dynamo DB Query optimization Tools & Practices Git version control Code review processes Testing methodologies API documentation Agile/Scrum methodologies What We Offer Competitive salary and benefits package Opportunity to work on edtech solutions Collaborative work environment with mentorship and learning opportunities Professional growth with hands-on experience Exposure to modern technology stack and best practices Impactful work that helps students learn Mathematics

title: Math Teacher (US Shift)
jobDescription: 🚀 Part-Time Math Trainer (Online, Grades UKG–8) – Work From Home 👩 🏫 Love teaching but tired of sales targets or PPT creations? At Bhanzu, you can focus 100% on what you love: teaching and inspiring students. ✔️ No student enrollments or lead calling ✔️ No content creation — we provide the curriculum ✔️ No marketing — just deliver joyful learning 🧠 Make Math Fearless, Fun & Foundational We’re on a mission to eliminate math fear and help young learners build lifelong confidence. As a Math Trainer, you’ll conduct high-impact online classes for students across UKG to Grade 8 — using engaging methods and real-life examples to bring math concepts to life. 🌍 Join a global learning movement — over 30,000 students, 15+ countries, and counting! Founded by Neelakantha Bhanu, the World’s Fastest Human Calculator and TEDx speaker. 📝 What You’ll Do Deliver engaging, intuitive, and joyful online math classes Use real-world stories, analogies, and examples to simplify concepts Customize your approach based on learner needs and age Track progress and share feedback with parents Teach students from India, US, UK, ANZ, GCC & more Follow Bhanzu’s pedagogy and training guidelines ✅ What You Need Strong command over school-level math (UKG–Grade 8) Bachelor’s degree in Math, Science, Engineering, or related field Excellent English communication with a neutral/clear accent Prior teaching experience preferred (online or offline) Quiet space, laptop, webcam, mic, stable internet, power backup ⏰ Time Commitment & Slots (IST) 3 to 6 hours/day | 6 days/week (1 weekday off) Preferred Slot: 2 AM – 7 AM 📝 Note: Final slot allocation will depend on your availability and performance in the selection process. 💰 Compensation Per-session pay + monthly performance bonuses Most trainers earn ₹80000–₹90,000/month Top performers earn ₹100,000+ Payout varies by slot, sessions handled, and region 🌟 Why Join Bhanzu? ✔️ No sales, enrollment, or marketing pressure ✔️ No content creation — ready-made lessons provided ✔️ Dynamic, high-energy work culture ✔️ Be part of a global team of 1100+ educators ✔️ Regular upskilling via Bhanzu’s curated training programs ✔️ Real impact — help children build confidence in Math 📋 Selection Process Screening Call (10 mins) Live Demo (15–25 mins, content shared in advance) Orientation & Training

title: HRBP - Night Shift
jobDescription:
About Us: At Bhanzu , our mission is to make math engaging, sparking curiosity and confidence in young learners. Bhanzu has successfully raised a $16.5M Series B funding round, led by Epiq Capital, with support from Z3Partners! We are changing the way math is learned and are blossoming into India's leading math education company, positively impacting students across 15+ countries. Through Bhanzu, we aim to eradicate Math Phobia across this globe, and enable our students to pursue careers in Stem Fields, Coding, Analytics, AI and much more by ensuring their core math fundamentals are strong As an HR Business Partner (HRBP) on our Night Shift, you'll act as a strategic advisor and partner to our leadership teams. Your role will focus on driving employee engagement, performance management, and providing people-centric solutions aligned with business goals. You will play a critical role in supporting our global teams and ensuring seamless HR operations during off-hours.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Conduct regular 1-on-1s and skip-level meetings, and prepare reports and actionable items on the same. Have a deep understanding of MIS and data reporting, and the ability to churn out reports on a timely basis. Plan, organise, and execute employee engagement activities. Strong business and HR acumen, including strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and self-initiative. Understand the business trends and people implications, connecting and integrating insights in order to diagnose and identify interventions needed to improve Business effectiveness. Deploy and drive HR projects and programs for employees based on the needs of the business, and also HR programs related to compensation, rewards and recognition, employee development and career progression, performance management, and workforce optimisation. Partner with HR Ops teams to innovate, improve, align, and drive the efficiency of organisation-wide HR programs and initiatives. Facilitate or chip into business conversations that drive the people strategies to enable a positive business impact. Applies understanding of how a business operates, financially and strategically, analyses key business drivers, and integrates insights into priorities and plans. Implement HR Programs, Policies, and Strategies through management of the employee life cycle.

title: Business Manager
jobDescription: About Bhanzu At Bhanzu , we’re on a mission to eradicate global math phobia by creating the world's most engaging and effective math learning experiences. Founded by world math record holder Neelakantha Bhanu, Bhanzu blends speed math techniques with real-world applications to help students become confident, curious, and future-ready learners. With students across India, the USA, UAE, and more, we are scaling rapidly—and sales is at the heart of this journey. 🚀 Role Overview We are looking for a high-impact Business Manager – Ed Tech Sales to lead a dynamic sales team, drive revenue performance, and help us scale Bhanzu’s offerings across new regions and verticals. This is a mission-critical leadership role focused on mentoring teams, optimizing conversions, and delivering outstanding customer experience in a fast-paced Ed Tech environment. 💼 Key Responsibilities Lead, coach, and manage a team of 20–40 sales executives (Inside Sales or Direct Sales) Own monthly revenue targets and sales KPIs across assigned geographies or pods Design and execute growth strategies to expand market reach and drive user acquisition Conduct weekly performance reviews, pipeline health checks, and skill workshops Drive performance through metrics: demo-to-sale %, show-up %, AOV, conversion rate Ensure CRM (Lead Squared/Zoho) hygiene and reporting discipline Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to improve lead quality and close loops on feedback Represent Bhanzu values in candidate hiring, parent communication, and team culture ✅ What Makes You a Great Fit 6–10 years of experience in B2C sales, team leadership, or business growth roles Previous experience in Ed Tech is a strong plus Excellent people management and coaching ability Comfortable with fast iteration, performance pressure, and operational agility Strong data orientation: ability to read dashboards, fix funnel leaks, and forecast accurately Superior communication and persuasion skills in English + 1 regional language 🎓 Educational Background Bachelor’s degree in Business/Marketing/Engineering or related field MBA/PGDM is a plus but not mandatory 🎁 What You’ll Gain at Bhanzu Be part of a fast-scaling Ed Tech startup backed by global investors Steep learning curve and high-growth career opportunities Merit-driven incentives and quarterly rewards Opportunity to shape the math learning experience of millions of students
